title: Concept: Form submits over plaintext HTTP in html — review required
description: In html, a form posts to an http URL. The browser sends the body over the wire before any redirect can occur, so a redirect to HTTPS does not protect the submission. Mixed-content blocking does not apply to top-level form navigation, which is why the pattern survives in older pages.
applicability: html templates that render authentication or checkout forms.
risk: Credential and payment data disclosure in transit; MEDIUM severity.
